newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Mint tenders for 50,000 kg nickel.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Mint tenders for 50,000 kg nickel.

text.p: The U.S. Mint said on Wednesday it was seeking 50,000 kg of nickel cathodes or briquettes for delivery in the weeks beginning June 30 and July 7.
Offers should be submitted by fax to the Mint before 10 a.m. EDT (1400 GMT) on June 3.

The Mint said it sought the nickel in two lots. The first lot was for 25,000 kg of nickel to be delivered by truck to Olin Corp in East Alton, Ill. The second lot also was for 25,000 kg, to be delivered by truck to PMX Industries in Cedar Rapids, Iowa.
